profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer who likes backend systems work and loves nailing developer experience in an AI-native environment. Happy in any modern stack and most experienced in C# and C++.

My current role is leading a engineering squad building the platform and tooling to enable agentic experiences for Outlook.

I'm experienced in building & maintaining engineering systems with a focus on Developer Experience. I drive clarity and cross-team collaboration to get from an idea to a shipped experience.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Engineering lead on a new C# service that is the platform for agentic actions in Outlook.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Helped lead development of a cross-platform C++ framework allowing desktop apps to more easily build their application layer on top of the WebView2 runtime. Used by Outlook, Copilot, and other Microsoft applications supporting millions of daily users.

Release engineering manager helping keep Outlook up to date on users' machines. Release pipelines, security, monitoring, etc.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Engineer on the Outlook Application & Service Architecture and Frameworks team.

Previously, I worked primarily in C++ on the win32 Outlook client. My team owned the search feature in Outlook and was focused on service-powered experiences as we improved search performance and key metrics for our users. Additional work on a C#/XAML telemetry analysis tool.

positions.title: Software Enginnering Intern
positions.description: Engineer on Outlook Desktop Search team

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Designed and built an after-action event reporting system with important metrics for clients to gain business insights to increase efficiency. Built using Python to interface with a Postgres database and generate summary PDFs that provided key insights on performance and were automatically sent to clients each day.

positions.title: Public Relations Intern
positions.description: Spearheaded effort to spread the word of Museum events to the Harvard and Greater Boston communities. In Fall 2015, helped increase museum special event attendance 135% over the previous year, setting an all time attendance record.

company.name: Harvard Museums of Science and Culture

positions.title: Marketing and Development Intern
positions.description: Won the Harvard Club of Dallas 2015 Summer Community Service Fellowship for public service or non-profit work in Dallas and worked to aid HRI's mission to serve those seeking immigration relief in the United States.

company.name: Human Rights Initiative of North Texas Inc.

honors.title: Graduated Cum Laude and with English Honors in Computer Science
Gold Crown
honors.description: Served as Editor-in-Chief of 12th consecutive CSPA Gold Crown-winning newspaper, The ReMarker.
honors.issuer: Issued by Columbia Scholastic Press Assocaition · Mar 2015
